svg.title: Ilorium reference architecture v0.1
svg.desc: Reference architecture as decided in architecture-v1.md; only M0 (the verifier) exists. Four branches: organism, evidence, independent verification, public commons and governance. Bottom diagrams show evidence flow, an actual four-leaf Merkle structure and independent human stop control.
svg.text: Reference architecture / a map of responsibilities
24 OCT 2026 · Only M0 exists · Nothing deployed
Existing runtime, tools and business DB
M1+ / own isolated service; key custody in a separate daemon
M6 gate / basic stop before live actions
No agent access to human stop keys
M0 done / RFC 6962 tree, RFC 9162 proofs
C2SP signed note + sidecar; presence is not production
Consistency check + cosign; not challenge operators
C2SP v1.1.0 / public witnesses not yet available
M0 done / 384 vectors / never imports the Probe
Identity, keys, endpoints and kin links
Discover, challenge and serve open data
Derived read model; storage to decide
Rebuildable / not the source of truth
Public view of evidence and limits
Other indexes may present other views
Human Custodians / interim: founder alone, published
Responsible humans / Wardens where no human founder
Each component keeps its own trust boundary. A signed statement can still be incomplete or false.
Integrity against a cosigned root ≠ completeness or truth. Content is never in the tree, only hashes.
Control only within the declared boundary
The stop path must survive Probe and index failure.
DESIGN STATUS · Map of architecture-v1.md (2026-10-24). M0 exists; M1–M8 are planned. Libraries, index storage and costs are open; this drawing is not protocol.
